messages:
Amanda Chen: Heads up team — AcmeCorp POC progressing. They want private/on-prem deployment (VPC + HSM) for a 3‑month eval, then potentially a 12‑month commit. Sales asked me to check platform fee waiver and support discount for the POC. I attached the security questionnaire in the CRM.
Jason Park: Quick Q — what's their expected steady QPS and model mix? That drives GPU sizing and whether we can offer a reduced platform fee during POC.
Amanda Chen: Model mix: mostly 70B-equivalent LLMs (mix of generation and embeddings). Steady ~5 qps, burst to 20 qps. Storage + KV cache required. They insist on HSM-backed keys.
Leo Martínez: Platform fee waiver for POCs is possible but we have guardrails. Typical approach: waive platform fee for up to 60 days if customer accepts a minimum committed capacity or credits. For a 90-day POC + 12‑month commit ask, we can consider full waiver during POC if commit >= $300k ARR or equivalent cloud spend.
Priya Nair: @Leo can you confirm deal desk criteria? Also need to know requested support tier change and % discount.
Amanda Chen: They asked to waive the platform fee for the 3‑month POC and take Support Premium at 40% off for the first year as a booking incentive. Committed run rate after conversion estimated at $35k/month (~$420k annual).
Sanjay Reddy: Technical note — HSM adds some ops complexity. If Legal requires specific key custody language we need security & legal signoff. From infra side, HSM + onprem will push onboarding 2–3 weeks.
Priya Nair: 40% off Premium + platform fee waiver = escalates to RevOps/Finance approval. We generally cap margin concessions at 25% unless exec-approved. Need to present a clear rationale: strategic account, referenceability, upsell motion.
Amanda Chen: Customer is strategic in APAC; they indicated they'd be willing to be a reference and co‑market. Also want a short SLO carveout for the POC window.
Leo Martínez: Draft commercial ask for deal desk:

```
Commit: 12 months, $420k ARR equivalent
POC: 3 months platform fee waived
Support: Premium tier at 40% off year 1
Onboarding: HSM + onprem ops (2–3 week lead)
Value: Strategic APAC reference, marketing case study
```

Leo Martínez: If Finance/RevOps pushback, alternative concession: 25% off support + platform fee waived for 60 days, then platform fee reinstated pro-rata.
Priya Nair: @Amanda pls attach the security questionnaire answers and the customer's signed data processing terms. We need LegalBot to review indemnity and export controls.
LegalBot: Auto-check: found 2 clauses flagged — (1) broad indemnity, (2) customer requests source code escrow. Legal needs redlines before platform fee waiver or special SLA.
Amanda Chen: Noted. I'll get the signed DPA and push the redlines to Legal.
Sanjay Reddy: Ops ask: if we waive platform fee for full 90 days and they spin up 3 nodes full time, cost exposure is significant. Suggest limiting reserved baseline to 50% of expected capacity during POC with optional burst credits.
Leo Martínez: Good point. Add operational guardrail: POC environment capped to N GPUs (e.g., 3 GPUs), with auto-approval for compressed bursts up to X hours per month.
Amanda Chen: Sounds fair. I'll propose: Platform-fee waived for 90 days, environment capped to 3 GPUs, burst allowed 40 hours/mo. Support at 30% off as a middle ground pending deal desk.
Priya Nair: Submit to deal desk with those tradeoffs + statement of intent from the customer (reference & marketing). I'll route to Finance and RevOps.
Jason Park: FYI engineering needs the model checkpoint licensing confirmation — open-source OK? If they want any custom weights we need extra legal review.
Amanda Chen: Acme confirmed they will use our approved open checkpoints.
Priya Nair: Submitted initial packet to deal desk with recommended concessions. Ticket ID: DD-2026-338. Expect RevOps reply in 48–72h.
Amanda Chen: Thanks — I'll hold cadence with customer and pause any onboarding tasks that would incur charges until approvals. :thumbsup:
ops-deploy-bot: Deploy plan queued: onprem‑provision request pending approval.
Leo Martínez: If deal desk approves, SalesOps — please log the platform fee waiver as a one-time promo code tied to the contract so it doesn't become permanent.
Priya Nair: Will do. Will update thread when RevOps/Finance respond.
Amanda Chen: Appreciate everyone. I'll follow up with Legal redlines and the customer's signed marketing consent.
Jason Park: 👍
Priya Nair: closing loop — DD responded: pre-approval granted for 60-day waiver + 30% off support; full 90-day waiver needs CRO signoff. Raising to CRO now.
Amanda Chen: Got it. Pulling customer expectations down to 60 days for now and flagged CRO ask.
Priya Nair: Final note — if CRO approves, ensure contract SOW includes explicit POC platform-fee waiver clause and the GPU cap/burst terms.
